operations.body: https://github.com/dgoings/workbook/pull/139: -rcN grammar and ordering in release-version.sh; previous-tag discovery through one helper (stable ignores rcs; an rc must clear every tag); planner skips the changelog check for an rc; publisher flags --prerelease, uses Unreleased as notes, leaves the tap alone; release.yml skips the tap checkout for an rc. 18 new script tests; whole-branch review rehearsed the first run end to end under dash.
